prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Grid layout redesign for adoption certificate screen: Redesign the adoption certificate screen to a grid layout to present pet details, name input, and certificate preview in a balanced grid format.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "grid", "headline": "Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "body": "Review your pet's profile and confirm adoption to bring them to your desktop."}}
1: [adoption, new_flow] Starter accessory selection step insertion: Insert a new starter accessory selection screen right before the adoption certificate step so users can customize their pet with a starter item.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_accessory_selection", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_accessory_selection": {"headline": "Choose a Starter Accessory", "body": "Pick an accessory for your desktop pet companion.", "layout": "grid", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Starter items", "style": "playful", "action": "choose"}]}}
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop rendering breakdown status on waiting screen: Display explicit status updates on desktop rendering initialization and overlay preparation on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"hint": "Initializing desktop graphics context and desktop overlay rendering engine...", "show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true}}
3: [home, notification] Desktop spawn chime notification toggle on waiting screen: Add an audio alert notification toggle on the waiting screen so users get an audible chime when their pet spawns.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "Play a soft chime when your pet arrives on your desktop."}}
4: [sign_in, hint] Account email match guidance hint on sign-in screen: Add a clear hint on the sign-in screen reminding users to sign in with their existing account email to prevent pet reset.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Sign in with the email used previously to automatically restore your existing desktop pet."}}
5: [adoption, redesign] List layout redesign for friend selection screen: Switch the pet selection screen to a clean vertical list layout highlighting each pet's unique traits and animations.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "list", "headline": "Choose Your Desktop Pet Companion", "body": "Select a pet companion from the available options below."}}
6: [adoption, new_screen] Pet personality selection screen insertion: Add a pet personality selection screen before photo upload where users select their pet's demeanor (playful, calm, or energetic).
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "new_pet_personality", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_pet_personality": {"headline": "Select Pet Personality", "body": "Choose how your pet companion behaves on your desktop.", "layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Personality type", "style": "playful", "action": "choose"}]}}
7: [sign_in, hint] Browser authentication popup fallback hint on sign-in screen: Add a troubleshooting hint below the sign-in options explaining how to unblock sign-in popups if the screen stalls.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "If the sign-in window does not appear, check your web browser popup blocker settings."}}
8: [home, wait_info] Graphics system initialization status list on waiting screen: Add a graphical preparation checklist component to the waiting screen detailing window overlay and sprite loading progress.
   config: {"waiting": {"components": [{"type": "checklist", "label": "Desktop Initialization Status", "style": "subtle"}]}}
9: [sign_in, incentive] Cloud save badge incentive on sign-in screen: Display a prominent cloud save badge on the sign-in screen emphasizing automated pet backup upon sign-in.
   config: {"sign_in": {"body": "Sign in to enable automatic cloud backup for your desktop pet and accessories.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Automatic Cloud Pet Backup Included", "style": "highlight"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigns the adoption certificate screen using a grid layout while preserving the official certificate job and messaging.
Inserts a new accessory selection screen into the onboarding flow while retaining all required onboarding steps.
The waiting screen hint replaces the indication that the pet is being made with technical graphics engine context.
Adds a chime notification option to the waiting screen, which is permitted within onboarding.
Adds helpful guidance copy to the sign-in screen without violating data or pricing rules.
Redesigns the friend selection screen into a list format while maintaining its core function of choosing a pet.
Inserts a new pet personality screen into onboarding without removing any required steps.
Adds a troubleshooting hint on the sign-in screen to help unblock popup authentication.
Adds a progress checklist component to the waiting screen as allowed customization.
Adds a cloud save informational badge to the sign-in screen without violating fair design or pricing rules.
